Event Music

Composed by Our Students

Music heard throughout the Collage this evening was composed and produced by students of the 8th Grade Music Technology Studios, created in BandLab for Education and shared anonymously.

Original Composition No. 1 — loops, layering & arrangement

Original Composition No. 2 — sampling & beat construction

Original Composition No. 3 — multi-track loop arrangement

Original Composition No. 4 — hip-hop influenced production
